story.paragraph: Two men walk down a wooden staircase in a dimly lit industrial facility filled with pipes and machinery. They reach the bottom and walk away from the camera. In a close-up view, a mechanical claw releases a round, textured object onto a surface, where it rolls away amidst steam.
story.summary: Two men walk through an industrial facility while a mechanical claw drops a round object onto a surface.
